cover.coreProposition: Physical persistence, semantic compatibility, recoverability, and activation authority are four distinct states; durable memory must be re-admitted after a model, writer, reader, or embedding change before it becomes authoritative for the new runtime.
cover.visualMetaphor: A sealed archive passes intact through a luminous threshold, but its projected meaning separates into aligned and misaligned layers on the far side.
cover.semanticObject: One intact glass archive capsule crossing a semantic threshold into offset memory layers
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with deep navy space, an indigo threshold, cyan aligned layers, one restrained amber misalignment, dimensional depth, and generous negative space
